extracted.intended_audience: authors, instructors, booksellers, and customers of Hachette Book Group (people seeking submission, purchasing, returns, permissions, or rights information)
extracted.subtask_description: A publisher FAQ listing policies and procedural requirements for manuscript submissions, desk/examination copies, returns, permissions, subrights, technical support, and customer service interactions with Hachette Book Group.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manuscript submissions and unsolicited queries
rubrics_metrics.description: Publishers in the Hachette Book Group are not able to consider unsolicited manuscript submissions and unsolicited queries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unsolicited manuscripts, submissions, and queries will not be answered and the publisher will have the right to destroy any unsolicited material or mail without returning to the sender. If you want a manuscript considered, first enlist the services of an established literary agent; many agencies are listed in Bowker’s Literary Market Place (LMP).

rubrics_metrics.name: Desk copies — eligibility and process
rubrics_metrics.description: Complimentary desk copies of any adopted, required text are available for qualified instructors at accredited colleges and universities in the U.S. and Canada; examination copies are available to instructors who wish to consider titles for adoption.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All requests are subject to approval and stock availability. Visit www.hachetteacademic.com for submission instructions or contact academic@hbgusa.com for assistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Returns — who can return
rubrics_metrics.description: These addresses are for RETURNABLE accounts wishing to make overstock returns; accounts set up as returnable do not need authorization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an account needs to check returnable status, they can contact customer service via e-mail or phone (800-759-0190). If you are set up as Non-Returnable, call customer service for assistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Returns — timeframe for returnable accounts
rubrics_metrics.description: Returnable accounts can return any book for any length of time as long as the books are In Print and In Good Condition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Returns — addresses and return types
rubrics_metrics.description: Separate return addresses are specified for whole copy returns and for stripped returns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Whole copy returns: HACHETTE BOOK GROUP, Attn: Returns Department, 322 South Enterprise Blvd., Lebanon, IN 46052. Stripped returns only: Hachette Book Group Retail Sales & Marketing, Attn: Stripped Cover Returns, 326 South Enterprise Blvd, Lebanon, IN 46052.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strippable covers — identification and rules
rubrics_metrics.description: To tell if an item is strippable, look for an inverted triangle with an (S) in it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Paperback books with a retail price of $6.95 or less have strippable covers regardless of product code (MM, TR, PB). Calendars are strippable, but the cover with the barcode on it is required. Contact customer service if you need further assistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Returns of NOP/OP (Not Our Publication/Out of Print)
rubrics_metrics.description: Hachette may accept returns on NOP/OP books for a short period after they are declared NOP/OP; after that they have specific thresholds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If returns are received after that short period, NOP/OP returns are returned to the customer if the amount received in a CARTON is FIVE or more. If it is below five, the books are destroyed. Contact customer service with questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Defective books and audiobooks procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: If you purchased a defective book or audiobook, contact customer service for replacement or assistance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For defective audiobooks on CD (missing or defective discs) and for defective books, e-mail customerservice@hbgusa.com for a replacement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ordering and bookseller account setup
rubrics_metrics.description: Hachette print and ebooks can be purchased via retailers listed on the website; booksellers may set up accounts to order specific books.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Look for the “Buy Book” dropdown on individual book pages for retailer info. Booksellers interested in accounts should e-mail customerservice@hbgusa.com. For discounts to corporations/organizations/non-bookstore retailers/wholesalers and related inquiries, e-mail special.markets@hbgusa.com. The catalog is available on Edelweiss.

rubrics_metrics.name: General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR) contacts (EU)
rubrics_metrics.description: Where Hachette products are offered for sale in the EU and subject to Regulation 2023/988 on General Product Safety, contact the Authorized Representative provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For print and ebooks contact Hachette Ireland (address and email info@hbgi.ie). For other Hachette products contact Hachette Livre (address and email support@hachettepro.fr).

rubrics_metrics.name: Contacting an author via the publisher
rubrics_metrics.description: Hachette cannot release contact information for any of its authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You may send a standard letter addressed 'c/o Author Mail, Hachette Book Group, 1290 Avenue of the Americas, New York, NY 10104' but the publisher cannot guarantee a response from any author.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyrights and permissions requests
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests to use material from a Hachette product must be submitted via a permissions form; permissions are charged and response times can be several weeks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fill out the provided form. If you believe a usage falls under 'fair use' as established by the U.S. Copyright Office, you do not need to request permission. For prop use, fill out the prop-use form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subrights inquiries — required information
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests for sub-rights (audiobook licensing, translation, dramatic rights, etc.) should include specific bibliographic details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Send details of your request including title/author/imprint/ISBN to HBGRights@hbgusa.com.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publisher's release form requests — required fields
rubrics_metrics.description: If you require a Publisher’s Release Form, request Hachette’s standard form by e-mail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E-mail pubrelease@hbgusa.com and be sure to include Producer Name, Title of Book, and Author in your request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical site problems and support response time
rubrics_metrics.description: Report site viewing or technical problems to website feedback and expect a response within 24–48 hours.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E-mail websitefeedback@hbgusa.com with details. For best performance, Hachette recommends updating your browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, Opera) and Flash; for Mac problems consult Apple.com.

rubrics_metrics.name: Titles not found / Out of Print explanation
rubrics_metrics.description: When a title is 'Out of Print' it is no longer produced and cannot be purchased from the publisher.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search for out-of-print titles at used bookstores or online booksellers who offer searches for out-of-print titles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editions and copyright page numbering explanation
rubrics_metrics.description: The copyright page indicates edition and printing by a numbered line beneath 'First edition'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For example, a book with 'First edition' and numbers '10 9 8 7' indicates the seventh printing of the first edition; the lowest number indicates the current printing.

rubrics_metrics.name: International locations / corporate divisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Hachette Book Group is part of Hachette Livre and has global divisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For information about divisions and locations outside the continental U.S., visit Hachette.com.
